_about: Corrections register for the publish finalize program, following Gray Matter's corrective-action protocol. One record per problem in corrections/<id>.md. A correction closes only with changed_files, regression_evidence and a named reviewer_approval. No record in this file is closed. Status vocabulary: open | closed. Owner decisions are marked decision_owner: owner. Merged records group related findings to fit the design map budget (docs/design/README.md, 9000 bytes). Updated 2026-11-14 at base 6f53a60 by the cross-surface review (docs/design/finalize/CROSS_SURFACE_REVIEW.md).

corrections.problem: Life was opt-in behind a preview-named flag that defaulted off. OD18 makes Life the default root, and it is on main (PR #211). A second Week surface (WeekFocusSurface) is still in the tree, reachable only through a path that cannot run; OD19 deletes it in wave 2. Life and Classic also remove a responsibility differently (undoable Details delete versus confirmation). Found on 2026-11-14: after a Life change, two Undo rows can show (the notice and a five-second Undo and Redo pair); Classic has two removal verbs; RoleDeleteConfirm and CrownTravel/DialGeometry are unreachable (findings X2, X3, X7).
corrections.decision_owner: decided: OD18 applied on main; OD19 open for wave 2. Owner decides X2 (one Undo row, and whether Redo stays in Life) and X3 (one removal verb).
